notes.title: Update 1.4.0 - Passenger Information & Bug Fixes
notes.notes: [p]This week's update adds passenger information displays and fixes a nasty bug where AI drivers just abandoned their trains shortly after entering.[/p][h2][/h2][h2]Full Changelog[/h2][h3]New[/h3][list][*][p]Added dotmatrix displays to the interior of trains. They display important information for passengers, like the line name, the destination, the next stop or on which side the doors are going to open[/p][/*][*][p]The dotmatrix displays at the front and back of the train now work and display line name and destination[/p][/*][*][p]You can also set custom text for the passenger and the front dotmatrix in the train menu (default: C)[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where trains could get stuck and never depart because the AI drivers were lazy and abandoned their trains mere seconds after their shift began. (they have now been fired)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where trains that a player set to "Drive without timetable" would still be eligible to receive a new timetable as soon as the player exited the driver seat.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor Bug Fixes & Improvements[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.3.5
notes.notes: [p]With this update, we have reinstated all changes from 1.3.4, with some additional changes & fixes.[/p][p][/p][h2]Full Changelog[/h2][h3]Changes[/h3][list][*][p]The reticle is now permanently visible for dispatchers[/p][/*][*][p]Increased render distance and made distance fog less pitch-black[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h3][list][*][p](From 1.3.4) Fixed an issue where distances shown in the track feed were not accurate[/p][/*][*][p](From 1.3.4) Fixed an issue where AI-driven trains would sometimes think they were already at a station when they were not close at all, which would also result in them leaving the train there if it was the last stop[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed players being able to take over AI-driven trains while the train was moving[/p][/*][*][p]Minor Bug Fixes & Improvements[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.3.4
notes.notes:
[p]This week, we got a small performance and bugfix patch.
[/p][h2]Full Changelog[/h2][h3]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Performance Improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some npc issues, specifically in multiplayer[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed train carriages sometimes not positioned correctly on it's wheels after spawning in until it started moving[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where dispatcher offices would sometimes fail to unload, for example when going to the main menu while dispatching[/p][/*][*][p]Trains on the yellow line can now also start from Founder's Square Platform 1 & 2 if the dispatcher sends a yellow line train there by accident[/p][/*][*][p]Minor Bug Fixes & Improvements [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Due to some critical bugs we have rolled the game back to version 1.3.3, we are working hard to get the update back into the game but there are some problems with AI Trains and Blocks not clearing that can make the game unplayable.[/b][/p]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.3.3
notes.notes: Fixed an issue where on-foot statuses didn't properly update for everyone but the host and fixed an issue where status would never update for newly joined players.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.3.2
notes.notes: This hotfix fixes an issue with approaching trains' route request not always resulting in dispatcher being notified.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.3.1
notes.notes: [p]This hotfix only fixes npc issues, specifically sitting npcs never exiting the train and npcs entering trains at the end of their timetable.[/p]

notes.title: Update 1.3.0 - Dispatcher Mode, Tunnel Visuals Overhaul & More
notes.notes: [p]Update 1.3.0 is our biggest yet, as it adds an entirely new way to play and addresses community feedback, like boring visuals and lots of minor improvements.[/p][p][/p][h2]Dispatcher Mode[/h2][p]You can now enter the dispatcher office of a station to become a dispatcher (only available at certain stations). From there, you are able to set routes for incoming and outgoing trains and make sure trains get to their destinations on time.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45330520/bb3834e2d05f072dae6371c07d29dd785ade15ff.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Tunnel Visuals Overhaul[/h2][p]The tunnels are no longer pitch-black and now have a more detailed texture, making the environment a lot less boring.[/p][p][/p][h2]Full Changelog[/h2][h3]New[/h3][p]- Added the following stations: Hillcrest, Skyline Plaza (between Pine Street/Hillcrest & Purple Bridge)[/p][p]- Added new line: Yellow Line - Runs between Hillcrest and Founder's Square, sharing most of the track with the purple line quad track[/p][p]- Added Dispatcher Mode: Play as a dispatcher in Weaver's Guild, Hillcrest Layup, Skyline Plaza, Founder's Square and Cheddar Street[/p][p]- Added statuses to the player list, which can now also be viewed with TAB instead of only through the lobby menu. These statuses also display in the Steam Friends List[/p][p][/p][h3]Changes[/h3][p]- Every scheduled train now has their own unique train number, which shows in the timetable and the player status[/p][p]- Updated Founder's Square with 2 additional platforms for the yellow line[/p][p]- Added the ability to customize camera sensitivity while zoomed[/p][p][/p][h3]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h3][p]- Overhauled Tunnel Visuals[/p][p]- Massive performance improvements[/p][p]- Improved automatic timetable assignment[/p][p]- Map now also shows cardinal directions in the top right corner[/p][p]- Improved passenger behaviour[/p][p]- Fixed the wrong cab hint not showing up when it should be in some circumstances[/p][p]- Fixed an issue that resulted in trains standing still for a couple of seconds and then teleporting when they were at full speed for everyone but the driver[/p][p]- Fixed some train sounds sometimes playing unintentionally[/p][p]- Quack[/p][p]- Minor bug fixes & improvements[/p]

notes.title: Playable on Steam Deck, Remote Play Together Enabled & Development Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Steam Deck Playable[/h2][p]Metrogether is now officially labeled as [b]Playable[/b] on Steam Deck and should also run on most linux pcs through Proton.[/p][p][/p][h2]Remote Play Together[/h2][p]Remote Play Together is now enabled for Metrogether. We have received requests to enable this feature so people can show the game to their friends and let them try it out for free before deciding on whether they should buy it.
[b]NOTE:[/b] All players in the Remote Play Together session share the same player, there is no actual local multiplayer functionality that works with Remote Play Together.[/p][p][/p][h2]Dispatcher Mode Development Update[/h2][p]We know you're all excited for dispatcher mode and we are getting closer to releasing this update.[/p][p]It took a little bit longer than we initially thought to bring this to life with multiplayer in mind, and we aren't done yet, but we're excited to share this in-development screenshot with you:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45330520/010d5e8f66e8369e0f1e8ddbe4ec7aeb906114b9.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.2.1
notes.notes: [p]This week, we got a small performance and bugfix update that should reduce crash frequency and improve overall performance.[/p][p][/p][h2]Full Changelog[/h2][h3]Changes[/h3][list][*][p]Speeding Score Penalty is now slightly more lenient[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Improved rendering, increasing performance and reducing crashes that occur during regular gameplay[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where non-host players desync could result in their train despawning while they were still operating it[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where non-host players desync could result in npcs and trains not spawning near them anymore[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a block never emptying on the soutbhound local line from Bank to Purple Bridge[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that resulted on collisions failing to work in the tunnels near Purple Bridge[/p][/*][*][p]Minor bug fixes & improvements[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]This patch is compatible with Update 1.2.0 and players of both versions can play together, but some of the changes only have an effect if the host is on version 1.2.1.[/p]

notes.title: Update 1.2.0 - New Stations, Quad Track & More
notes.notes:
Our first map extension is now live! We heard all your feedback and have expanded the map with a new area, featuring quad track where express trains overtake local trains as they bypass three of the four new stations between Pine Street and Founder's Square.

This update also contains a bunch of bug fixes and performance improvements, aswell as password-protected lobbies and other multiplayer quality of life improvements.

[h2]Full Changelog[/h2]
[h3]New[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added the following stations: Purple Bridge, Bank, Royal Gardens, Rosengard Street
[*]Added express trains. On the Purple Line, express trains overtake local trains by skipping Purple Bridge, Royal Gardens and Rosengard Street
[*]Added password-protected lobbies: Players can now set passwords for their lobby on all lobby types. Players can choose to hide password-protected lobbies in the lobby browser.
[/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Timetable now also shows the route's name and destination
[*]Friends Only lobbies now also show up in lobby browser for eligible players
[*]Lobbies with friends are now marked in the lobby browser with a green friend symbol
[*]Friends now have a green `Friend` label in the lobby menu
[*]Friends now have a green name in chat (unless they are also the host)
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where trains could still get a route assigned after they had already despawned
[*]Fixed an issue where some Score Penalties could trigger multiple times in quick succession, when only one mistake was made by the driver
[*]Fixed an issue that resulted in way too many NPCs spawning in certain circumstances
[*]Fixed an issue where the Request Route keybind would click the Request Route button on all previously operated train cabs, requesting routes for all of them
[*]Performance improvements, especially for loading in areas
[*]Increased overall brightness slightly
[*]Adjusted tunnel lamps
[*]Keybinds can now be reset to default
[*]Quack
[*]Minor bug fixes & improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.1.4
notes.notes:
We've been pretty silent the last couple of weeks, but that's because we've been busy working on the next big update that will add a section of quad-track for express and local trains with a couple of new and unique stations that are placed between Pine Street and Founder's Square.

We were able to find the time to work on this small performance and bugfix patch for the time being. This should get rid of the little stutters (or sometimes even crashes) that happen while moving through he world, which became very noticeable since we added lamps to the tunnels.
[h2]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Improved dynamic world loading, game should no longer stutter or sometimes crash when approaching areas that need to be loaded in
[*]Fixed AI drivers taking over vacant trains which were partly or entirely outside of platform bounds, resulting in them driving down the tracks without a route set and sometimes driving into oncoming traffic
[*]Fixed an issue where some Score Penalties could trigger multiple times in quick succession, when only one mistake was made by the driver
[*]Fixed an issue where requested routes could be unset due to them timing out even while the train that requested it was currently moving through the track section the route is for (this could only happen when routes time out 5 minutes after being set which is still the intended and current behaviour)
[*]Minor bug fixes & improvements
[/list]

This patch is compatible with patches 1.1.0-1.1.3 and players of any of these versions can play together.

notes.title: Patch 1.1.3
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, today we just got a small patch with a couple of fixes and improvements to the overall experience.
[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Decreased NPC hitbox size to make walking through a crowded train less frustrating. NPCs may still block you off but it's possible to get through more often
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed train timetable & train sounds still displaying sometimes after teleporting away
[*]Fixed an issue with one of the AI Driver personalities that would cause them to stop too early, sometimes leaving the train partly outside of the platform
[*]Fixed an issue that caused AI Drivers not to activate on the correct side of the train in some cases
[*]Fixed an issue where Route Requests were ignored at Founder's Square
[*]Fixed an issue that resulted in trains able to spawn on incorrect platform if another train was already occupying the correct one
[*]Fixed multiple issues related to AI Drivers getting stuck
[*]Minor bug fixes & improvements
[/list]

This patch is compatible with patches 1.1.0-1.1.2 and players of any of these versions can play together.

notes.title: Patch 1.1.2
notes.notes:
Today's patch focuses on a wide spread of improvements. As always, we are very thankful for all the feedback you have provided us with.
[h2]New[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added an option to disable headbob
[*]Added a hint on how to open a lobby to the lobby browser menu
[/list]
[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Shaved off a total of 3 minutes from the timetable in both directions, addressing player feedback of having to wait too long at stations
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed multiple issues related to passengers getting on or off the train
[*]Fixed an issue that resulted in some players not appearing in the player list
[*]Fixed an issue that prevented checking tickets on some sitting passengers
[*]Fixed AI drivers forgetting to request a route
[*]Fixed an issue that caused the reticle to stay on-screen indefinitely
[*]Fixed chat input getting smaller when lots of chat messages were present
[*]Fixed player inputs staying unresponsive through sessions (e.g. when you were in a menu when you left the lobby)
[*]Fixed camera able to clip into walls after jumping
[*]Minor bug fixes & improvements
[/list]

This patch is compatible with both 1.1.0 and 1.1.1 and players of any of these versions can play together.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.1.1
notes.notes:
Fixes:
[list]
[*]Fixed any stick input on controllers sounding the horn. Now only stick presses will activate the horn.
[/list]
This hotfix is compatible with 1.1.0 and players of both versions can play together.

notes.title: Update 1.1.0 - AI Driver Personalities & Tunnel Improvements
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, welcome to the first regular update. We have heard your feedback, and understand that many of you think the map is too small. We agree, but we obviously couldn't add new stations in less than a week. Instead, we have focused our initial efforts on other areas such as replayability and other requested features.
[h2]AI Driver Personalities[/h2]
AI Drivers now have different personalities that have an impact on their driving style and how punctual they are and those personalities are visually reflected in the outfit they wear. This should increase the variety of situations you can encounter, especially in single player.

Currently, these personalities do not differ too much from the original driver, but we can easily tweak them if they do not have enough of an effect.
[h2]Full Changelog[/h2]
[h3]New[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added AI Driver personalities
[*]Added a train horn
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added lamps to most tunnel sections
[*]Fixed characters skin variant loading broken while spawning in. This resulted in player characters not loading the correct variant when joining and npcs often having the same variants
[*]Fixed the `/player` aka `/who` command always resulting in a `Not looking at a player` error even if looking at another player
[*]Fixed option to spawn at station appearing on the map while operating a train even though you cannot teleport in that situation
[*]Potential fix for AI drivers sometimes getting stuck in front of a proceed signal
[*]Fixed third person camera jittering while on a moving train
[*]Increased overall brightness slightly
[*]Minor bug fixes & improvements
[/list]

This update is not compatible with prior versions and all players must update to 1.1.0 to play together in this version.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
New day, new patch. Our focus in this patch was on improving the multiplayer experience.

[h2]Fixes & Improvements[/h2]
- Improved NPC Behaviour, they should no longer exit the train last-second and glitch through the doors and more npcs should now get off at the final station.
- Fixed some syncing issues that were mostly occuring at high latency
- Fixed some sound issues
- Minor bug fixes and improvements

This patch is compatible with 1.0.0 and 1.0.1 and players of any of these versions can play together, however, some of these improvements only work when the host is on version 1.0.2.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, today we released a small bugfix update to address some of the immediate issues in the 1.0 version.

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
- Fixed newly joined players unable to see color changes to trains that were done before they joined
- Fixed "Hand train over to AI" button not greyed out in trains without a timetable
- Fixed greyed out buttons still responding to hovering
- Fixed chat commands that were only usable by the host resulting in success messages even though they did not do anything (affected: /kick, /ban, /unban, /banlist, /clear true)

This patch is compatible with 1.0.0 and players of both versions can play together.
